name: cli-json-inspection-v1
selection: Every preparation recipe in the bundled catalog at baseline, sorted by id; no exclusions based on results.
comparison: Previous indent=2 output versus compact --json output; identical parsed JSON required.
metric: 100 * (1 - sum(compact text tokens) / sum(pretty text tokens))
reporting: Report all cases, aggregate, median and range. Round aggregate down for headline copy. No LLM calls, billing or task-token inference.
reuse_experiment: Run the existing native Worker/D1 controlled two-link IK correction-transfer regression without changing targets, scoring, solver or patch.
